sources.role: pinned core source for Virtual Boy device channels and core options
RetroArch host config, controller profile, save/state and system-directory contract
official Beetle VB core controllers, options and firmware documentation

paths.path: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/retroarch/retroarch.cfg or $HOME/.config/retroarch/retroarch.cfg; core options may be in retroarch-core-options.cfg or a Beetle VB override
paths.naming: RetroArch key = "value" syntax; this core's options are vb_3dmode, vb_anaglyph_preset, vb_sidebyside_separation, vb_color_mode, vb_right_analog_to_digital, vb_opposite_directions and vb_cpu_emulation

Existing RetroArch controller profile contract: main input_playerN_<button>_btn/_axis and autoconfig input_<button>_btn/input_<axis>_axis; Beetle VB core exposes left D-pad, right D-pad, A/B/L/R, Select/Start and right analog channels

paths.path: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/retroarch/saves/ (or configured savefile_directory; unset may place beside content)
paths.naming: RetroArch frontend basename .srm and core-declared sidecars; Beetle VB core has no separate native save path

paths.path: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/retroarch/states/ (or configured savestate_directory; unset may place beside content)
paths.naming: RetroArch .state for slot 0, .stateN for numbered slots, .state.auto for Auto
Beetle VB docs do not require an external BIOS file for the core; no firmware checksum asserted
Not applicable

notes: Beetle VB is a libretro core hosted by RetroArch. Its controller surface remains the existing RetroArch RetroPad/autoconfig contract; this record deliberately adds no standalone Beetle VB native controller writer. Core-specific vb_* options are authorable through RetroArch core-options files, while input bindings remain frontend-owned.
